review_description: Still waiting for meter to be changed.
We went for solar and battery and are pleased with the results so far.  Team put up the whole system in a  day and a half.
Your site and the ability to compare your suggestions for a quote which we used was a great help and enabled us to make a better informed decision
Friendly and helpful service. Would recommend to others.

Your help was fantastic, and so to, the web site with the canadian rating. I eventually opted for Phonosolar 195 watt panels with a 0/+3 tolerance and an sma inverter. The panels were tier 1, I could have got more for my money with Solaworx, but was concerned about some of the reviews about service, and time, being wary of the end of June changes. ODea's price for the system was better than  a similar quality system from SA quality home improvements. T Gill was comparable to Solaworx. I avoided the cheaper panel and inverter systems. Our panels will be installed next week.  Thanks again!
We found the information on the website invaluable for asking the right questions and I apologize for not responding to earlier emails.

We had difficulty finding a supplier who was prepared to travel to our county town so we opted for a local supplier (who probably has the same distance to travel) but was  happy to come on site  to give up a quote.
It was great to use someone local and still be very confident with the product we were having instaled.
